description:
Make the CLI and server document diff read both versions through one git module object reader, removing the last libgit2 blob reader in the document commands.

## Background

- `document_diff` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:581-632`) and `get_document_diff` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:764-814`) each open libgit2 and call `read_file_from_git` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:848-862`) twice, then render a unified diff with the `similar` crate.
- Outside git the CLI variant fails with "Not a git repository", and the server variant returns `PathReadError::Other("Document diff not available (requires git repository with history)")`.
- Tests: `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/document_history_tests.rs:263`, `:305`, and the server's `crates/server/tests/server_integration/document_api_tests.rs`.
- Kept as one change for a build reason: `read_file_from_git` is private, and an uncalled private method fails the zero-warning build.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Both variants read the two versions through one object reader on the executor's selected code checkout (`code_checkout()`). `read_file_from_git` no longer exists, and neither variant uses git2.
- [hard] REQ-02: Diff output is byte-identical, so the CLI and server diff tests pass unchanged; outside git each variant fails as today.
- [hard] REQ-03: A CLI test with the counting stand-in first on `PATH` asserts one `cat-file` invocation for `jit doc diff`; today the diff runs in libgit2 and records none, so it fails.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Document diff reads both versions through one git process
